Reminder pageSection 1

How To Literally Do Anything

What you send out — thought, emotion and deed together — is what you shift into. Change the frequency, hold it moment to moment, and let go of how it will come.
THE PULL OUT METHOD
  1. NOTICEHurt, fear or doubt = off-balance with love.
  2. PULL OUT"I am the structure." Don't react the same way.
  3. CALM DOWNCompletely, before anything else.
  4. BE GRATEFULFor what is already here. Don't reject it.
  5. LIFT & PROJECTFeeling, words, tone and action — all positive.
  6. LET GO OF THE HOWNo script. No expectation of outcome.
  7. ACT & HOLDMoment to moment, even if nothing changes.

If you slip, go back to step 2.

Remember
  • You are the structure. Nobody is outside of you.
  • Change the frequency — then hold it.
  • Know it 100%. A 99% download won't play.
  • Act. Be grateful. Accept any outcome.
  • "You have to know it in order to see it."
When this happens…
Someone is upset with meKind tone, no judgment: "I understand. Can we talk later?" Accept any outcome.
Something seems missingGratitude → know you already have it → take action → watch for synchronicity.
It won't shiftDoubting or scripting the how? If not, it's a lesson: accept it, pass it with excellence.
Key words
Structure the field you are made of · Shifting snapshot to snapshot · Timeline same frequency held · Crystallize make it solid · Condition any doubt or script · Knowingness 100% certainty
Open Section 1
Reminder pageSection 2

Mobilizing Structures

Before you react, pull out to zero point and see where you are. The outcome follows the emotion you hold most — so don't reject what you see: overwrite it.
THE OVERWRITE PROTOCOL
  1. NOTICE THE DROP"I recognise what I just did."
  2. PULL OUT"I am a hologram." Step back, like watching a screen.
  3. ZERO POINTStill and neutral. "Thank you for showing me where I'm at."
  4. CHOOSEThe positive, through the heart. "I am." "I know."
  5. AMPLIFYFeel it like an actor on cue — until goosebumps.
  6. HOLD, HOLD, HOLDSteady, 100%, even if the scene doesn't change.
  7. DROP ITRelease it to the field. No expectations of how.

Result: the next reality is built on the new frequency.

Remember
  • Neutral first, then choose.
  • Doubt = flicker. The field picks what you fed most.
  • Gratitude neutralizes. Then overwrite — never reject.
  • Every moment is a brand-new reality. Let the past go.
  • Say "I am" and "I know" — never "I will".
When this happens…
Bad news or a forecast"That's their projection. Love and light." Give gratitude, then project what you choose.
A negative thought appearsDon't fight it. Thank it, go neutral, then overwrite with a stronger positive.
Forgot why I came inRecall the last room: where I was, what I was thinking and doing.
Key words
Zero point still, neutral awareness · 1 + 1 = 3 two realities merge into a third · Flicker what doubt does · Overwrite stronger, not rejecting · Drop it release with no conditions · False language "I will"
Open Section 2
Reminder pageSection 3

Fluctuating Realities

The field always delivers what you truly feel. Saying something else adds a dense overlay, and you get your true wish by a hard route. There is no white lie. Your heart is your compass.
THE TRUTH CHECK
  1. PAUSE & FEELWhat do I truly feel, under politeness or habit?
  2. PEEL THE LAYERSHeart — or ego, fear, wanting to impress, greed?
  3. SAY IT KINDLYBrief and polite. No full explanation owed.
  4. CORRECT AN OVERLAYSaid yes but meant no? Fix it honestly, now.
  5. SWITCH IF YOU DROPGratitude for everything you have.
  6. PROJECT & RELEASEPositive, from the heart. Let go of when and how.
Remember
  • Energy is energy: the more potent frequency wins.
  • Karma = accumulated false pretense.
  • Things are not who you are. Heart or ego?
  • A to B = AB. No time — the in-between can be skipped.
  • Stay with what resonates. Don't judge.
When this happens…
About to say yes but mean no"I'm sorry, something came up — can we do it another time?"
Dizzy or sick after a big shiftRest and integrate — and check your body (it may be health, e.g. low sugar).
Unsure which teaching to trustDoes it resonate with my heart? Is it given from the heart or from greed?
Key words
Overlay saying ≠ feeling · Potent the stronger frequency · Stoppage how a hidden wish arrives · Karma accumulated false pretense · Bilocation A to B = AB · Resonate true for my heart now

Reminder pageSection 4

Money Structure

A fixed price is a condition that narrows your field to money only. Keep your job and pay your bills — and give from the heart, let people choose, and be the abundance you want to see.
OPENING THE FIELD
  1. SPOT THE CONDITIONA price, "only if you give back", "only money can do this".
  2. KEEP YOUR PLATFORMDo your job. Pay your bills.
  3. FOLLOW YOUR PASSIONAfter the bills, daily. Hold the excitement.
  4. GIVE FROM THE HEARTNo expectations. Let people choose what to give.
  5. ACCEPT WHAT COMESMoney, donation or gift. Don't reject money.
  6. HOLD AT 100%Short on money? Gratitude, know, don't drop.
  7. CHECK THE WANTHeart or ego? Only for me, or for others too?
Remember
  • A price is a code in the field.
  • Accept money — never limit yourself to it.
  • Exactly what you need, no more, no less.
  • If someone uses you, it stays in their reality.
  • Know it, feel it, project it.
When this happens…
The bank looks emptyDon't drop your emotion. Gratitude → "I have what I need" → act → let it come any way.
Someone could pay but just takesYou did your job. Their taking stays with them; another may give double.
I want somethingIs it from the heart or to show off? Let the field choose the best form.
Key words
Condition a price or demand · Heart structure giving with no condition · Open field infinite routes to receive · Platform job + heart work · Energy Philanthropy giving with nothing expected

Energy Philanthropy

Make giving from the heart your currency, and the field mirrors you. When you feel low, that's a location: neutralize it, then shift with potent gratitude and action.
SHIFT YOUR LOCATION
  1. RECOGNISE THE DROPThis shows where I am, not who I am.
  2. PULL OUT"I am a hologram." Think through the structure.
  3. SAY IT"Thank you for showing me where I'm at."
  4. NEUTRALIZEZero point: no input, no output.
  5. GRATITUDEFor everything you have, until you feel it.
  6. POTENT ACTIONPositive emotion and a positive deed.
  7. KEEP RECALLINGMoment to moment, until it crystallizes.

If you slip, start again at step 2.

Remember
  • Give from the heart; set no amount.
  • Accept what comes back, in any form.
  • Every moment is a new print of reality.
  • Know 100% that humanity is changing.
  • Let living things choose for themselves.
When this happens…
I feel low or stuckIt's a location. Thank it, neutralize, then potent gratitude and one good action.
I have to charge for somethingCover the real cost honestly; let extra support be freely chosen.
Ascension seems hopelessYou see the Earth you project. Believe it's changing; leave how and when to the field.
Key words
Energy Philanthropy giving as currency · Location where you are (X, Y) · Neutralize zero point · Recall re-creating in the now · Spiral the particle breathing

Reminder pageSection 6

The Soul, Letting Go & Disclosure

What you keep carrying, you keep projecting. Let go and forgive, replace the old picture with a positive one, and switch your emotion fast. You change yourself, not others.
SWITCH AND RELEASE
  1. RECOGNISEThe drop, or the old story replaying.
  2. PULL OUT"I am a hologram." If intense, leave the scene.
  3. MOVE YOUR BODYPhysical action shifts you fastest.
  4. GRATITUDEFor why you're here and what you have.
  5. LET GO & FORGIVE"From this moment I am at zero."
  6. REPLACE ITHold the positive version as your own.
  7. DROP BY DROPRepeat daily until it crystallizes.
Remember
  • Your soul runs many realities; you focus here.
  • No one may tell you your agreement.
  • Lessons repeat until you let go 100%.
  • Tune to the station you want to hear.
  • The old has to clear for the new.
When this happens…
A hard day wears me downGratitude for why you were there, then do something you enjoy. Move.
An old hurt or belief comes backForgive, start from zero, replace it with a positive picture.
Frightening newsDon't tune in. It's a transition. Stay positive; match the timeline you want.
Key words
Letting go stop projecting the old · Forgiveness release the frequency · Replace hold a new picture · Focus one reality of many · Ripple effect creation without end

Reminder pageSection 7

Stop. Transform. Move On.

The moment an emotion takes over: Stop. Transform it into a heart-felt positive feeling. Complete: it's done, leave it alone. At 100%.
